open: Send the analysis just done to a GAID hub draft
title: Analysis for a hub draft
description: Bundle the request, final answer and selected files and send them to the GAID hub as material for a new Workflow draft.
rawData: Raw data under user_data/ is included only when you select it. Content written in the request and answer is included, so review it before sending.
loading: Reading the analysis and file list.
truncated: Long text or per-file step lists were truncated. The bundle records the same limits.
emptyFiles: No files are available to send. You can download the request and answer alone.
excluded: Excluded {count} files from the list due to path or size limits, deletion or read failures.
sizeHelp: Up to 200 files, 5 MiB per file, 20 MiB per bundle. Files are read again when you send, so the bundle holds their current content.
note: Note about the Workflow to build (optional, up to 4,000 characters)
site: External hub to send the draft to
attach: Open a draft in the external hub and attach the downloaded analysis bundle. The download path does not upload files.
startDraft: Start a draft in the external hub
directHelp: You can also send the bundle directly to the configured external hub on this PC. If delivery cannot be confirmed, the bundle is downloaded.

path.direct: Sent to the external hub. If no new tab opens, use the draft link.
path.download-fallback: Could not confirm direct delivery, so the bundle was downloaded instead. Check whether the external hub already created a draft, then attach the bundle.
path.hub: Created a new GAID hub draft with the analysis bundle as its material.

errors.input: Check the file selection and note, then send again.
errors.session: The chat record was not found. Reopen the chat and try again.
errors.file: A selected file cannot be sent. Reopen the dialog to check the file list.
errors.size: A file or bundle exceeds the size limit. Select fewer files. If the chat record is too large, choose another chat.
errors.request: The analysis handoff request failed. Check the server connection and try again.

assessment: Researcher assessment: {outcome, select, useful {useful} needs-revision {needs revision} failed {failed} other {not recorded}} · {note}
noAssessment: No researcher assessment yet. Save one in the Workflow's trial record to send it along.
excludedFile: {path}: {reason, select, policy {path not allowed} unavailable {could not be read} too-large {over 5 MiB} file-limit {over the file limit} other {left out}}
